# The initial attendee overview chooses a short list or a status-count summary

The initial row clears its list, localizes the guest count and emits a bubbling visibility event. It renders at most three attendees as items and otherwise shows counts for ACCEPTED, TENTATIVE, DECLINED and NEEDS-ACTION. The dialog supplies event attendees and clears the row on reset. Accepted full-mode, organizer and asynchronous chunk/translation behavior are later phases; the first row patch does not establish their completion or measured performance.

Scope: Calendar read-dialog attendee overview.
